title: Practice: Since, till, by, before, after, in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I want a unicycle for my birthday.
exercises.why: «The preposition НА + Acc. is used: (a) to indicate the length of time one expects to stay some place, or the time something is expected to last; (b) after the verb опаздывать / опоздать to indicate the amount of time by which someone is late.» «Note also such expressions as: на следующий день — (next day).» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 73.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: НА + Accusative indicates how long something is expected to last. (DLI, Lesson 73)

exercises.q: У меня был инсульт в прошлом ___ (год).
exercises.prompt: I had a stroke last year.
exercises.why: «В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place.» «Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: В + Prepositional indicates the year or the month in which an event takes place. (DLI, Lessons 73 and 75)

exercises.prompt: The new bridge will have been completed by April.
exercises.why: «The preposition К + Dat. denotes the time by which an event takes place. (It answers the question „By what time?“) Он вернётся к двум часам. Приготовьте доклад к понедельнику.» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: К + Dative denotes the time by which an event takes place. (DLI, Lesson 77)

exercises.q: Сборщик мусора приходит три раза в ___ (неделя).
exercises.prompt: The garbage collector comes three times a week.
exercises.why: «В + Accusative is used: (a) to indicate the time of the day; (b) to indicate the day of the week; (c) to indicate how frequently something occurs.» «Note also the following expressions: В минуту опасности. В годы войны. Во время войны. В первый раз. В следующий раз. В последний раз.» «Units smaller than a week (day, hour etc.) take „В + Acc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 19 and 73.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: В + Accusative is used to indicate the time of the day, the day of the week, and how frequently something occurs. (DLI, Lessons 19 and 73)

exercises.q: В пятнадцатом ___ (век) Португалия была великой колониальной державой.
exercises.prompt: In the 15th century, Portugal was a great colonial power.
exercises.why: «В + Prepositional is used: (a) to indicate the year or the month (but never the week) in which an event takes place; (b) to indicate the beginning, the middle, the end or any other phase of a period in which an event takes place.» «Units larger than a week (month, year) take „В + Loc.“» — DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 73 and 75.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: В + Prepositional indicates the year or the month in which an event takes place. (DLI, Lessons 73 and 75)
